name: llmc_softmax_forward
goal: Port softmax_forward_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/softmax_forward.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T V` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 0.0001 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness.

museport.note: B=2, T=32 (llm.c: B=8, T=1024), V=2048 (llm.c: V=50257); total 131072 floats to stay under 200MB and finish CPU reference in seconds; outlier scaling by 20 preserved in host_prep; block size 256 (kernel 3 launcher forces 32 internally).
